# SCI-MAP v0.1 r0.7.1 Freeze-Only Errata Change Log

Status: bounded editorial and source-binding correction; scientific semantics
and stable normative identifiers unchanged

Prepared: `2026-08-28`

Revision r0.7.1 applies the exact owner directive archived in
`FREEZE_ONLY_ERRATA_R0.7.1.md`. It replaces the symbolic decision tuple with
named fields, corrects the `coverage_cut` wording, fixes identifier typography,
defines exact exposure-product aliases, narrows `SCI-MAP-REQ-010` grammar, and
replaces moving source descriptions with immutable revision/digest bindings.

The source manifest is externally SHA-bound by
`SOURCE_MANIFEST_R0.7.sha256`. New r0.7.1 byte-equality, view-parity,
owner-decision-parity, and PDF-QA reports preserve the r0.7 reports as history.

The inventory remains exactly 52 requirements (`SCI-MAP-REQ-001` through
`SCI-MAP-REQ-052`) and 25 predictions (`SCI-MAP-PRED-001` through
`SCI-MAP-PRED-025`). No estimator, response, exposure, support, covariance,
coadd, or lifecycle semantic change is made.
